precondition.description: The customer submits either JSON-RPC 2.0 or an ActivityStreams solicitation with natural-number entities, cells, and components, components no greater than entities, and entities no greater than cells plus components. The ActivityStreams path additionally requires provider-authored terms, their acceptance, and a capability attenuated to the exact request and provider-local write effect.

move.description: The provider attests its pinned Obsmetrologia source bytes and evaluates the separately implemented executable projection. An ActivityStreams invocation also appends the provider's readout, receipt, seller-side book entry, message history, event, and EAVT projection.

postcondition.description: The response carries the computed ranks, exact source digests, theorem references, conformance scope, and local cost; the ActivityStreams response also carries its receipt and provider book reference. Neither carrier claims formal extraction, implementation equivalence, settled price, or authority over the customer.

records: ActivityStreams ingress, offer, invocation, result or refusal, receipt, provider book entry, event, and EAVT facts when that carrier is used

customerOwned: meaning and provenance of submitted counts
supplierOwned: Obsmetrologia mathematical declarations and source history
